title: fix: keep tracking alive after malformed SSE chunks
author: AbarnaaSree
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

Fixes #13223  
References #13147

- Skips malformed JSON SSE events during post-response tracking.
- Continues processing later valid usage events so billing and tracking complete normally.
- Keeps malformed response content out of Worker logs.
- Adds one middleware-level regression proving a final Tinybird row is emitted with later valid usage.

## Validation

- Focused malformed-SSE Worker regression
- Full tracking observability test file: 34/34 passed
- Gen typecheck
- Biome on both changed files

gist.headline: The tracker keeps buzzing
gist.blurb: A few scrambled SSE crumbs no longer stop the hive ledger. Polli brushes them aside and keeps following the useful signals all the way to the final row.
gist.summary: Updated gen.pollinations.ai post-response tracking to skip malformed JSON SSE events and continue processing later valid usage events, ensuring the final Tinybird usage row is still emitted.
gist.impact: Streaming users and developers get reliable billing and usage tracking even when a response contains an occasional malformed SSE chunk, without that malformed content entering Worker logs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy streaming-data garden where a few broken pixel data fragments are gently swept aside while healthy usage-event fireflies continue along a glowing path into a Tinybird-style ledger terminal. Polli, wearing a tiny tracker visor, observes the flow as code-plants and flowers grow around the terminal.
